requiredEnvironments.missing: No physical iPad available in observed inventory
An additional named desktop GPU class/host is not available

source.dynamic: one pixel changes per completed batch; full source replaced/read each revision

soakScope: Each environment/backend campaign covers all four adapters concurrently for a full 30 minutes; no cross-backend or cross-environment duration aggregation.
admissionScope: Two complete original CPU-main and worker repetitions and two original GPU repetitions; original static-source/changing-optics budgets are separate from dynamic soak measurements.
memoryScope: Known image/executor storage and owned resource counts; browser heap, compositor and driver memory are not inferred.
betaRule: Missing, failed, diagnostic, software-rendered or short-duration evidence cannot close a required physical row. Phase 1 Safari progression waiver is not a passing timing result.
